allow.heading: Good morning, Alex.
allow.reason: The design's welcome-row greeting. The section exists (h1 with dynamic signed-in user name) but its copy is pinned by the app's e2e contract — e2e/dashboard.spec.ts asserts /good day/i on the heading — and spec copy wins over design sample copy. 'Alex' is design-sample user data; the app greets the real signed-in user.
